digest.component_or_area: rebar init command and store mounting
propositions: rebar init silently creates an empty orphan branch when the configured remote is unreachable or fetch times out, instead of failing with a diagnostic
_mount_or_create_branch and pending_init_attaches_to_existing rely only on local refs, so a failed fetch causes an existing remote branch to appear as a genuine first init
a shared tri-state remote-branch probe using git ls-remote must distinguish advertised (return 0), reachable-absent (return 2), and unreachable/timeout (return 124) to gate orphan creation
ensure_store_mounted_best_effort must treat unreachable remotes as do-not-auto-mount and return without error, allowing the subsequent strict path to fail closed with diagnostics
--force-new-store flag must authorize deliberate bootstrap only when reachability cannot be established; it must have no effect when the remote is reachable
failure messages must name the configured remote, branch, timeout where applicable, and offer concrete remediation (fetch/retry or force-new-store override)
